name: CheckCle-Monitoring-Agent
description: A monitoring agent for CheckCle that collects system metrics, Docker stats, and sends data to your CheckCle server for monitoring and alerting.

paths.name: Monitoring Data
paths.description: Path for storing monitoring agent data

paths.name: Monitoring Logs
paths.description: Path for storing monitoring agent logs

paths.name: Host Proc
paths.description: Host proc filesystem for system monitoring

paths.name: Host Etc
paths.description: Host etc directory for system configuration

paths.name: Host Sys
paths.description: Host sys filesystem for system monitoring

paths.name: Host Root
paths.description: Host root filesystem for system monitoring

paths.name: Host Var Run
paths.description: Host var/run directory for system monitoring

paths.name: Host Dev
paths.description: Host dev directory for system monitoring

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the monitoring agent web interface

variables.name: Agent ID
variables.description: Unique identifier for this monitoring agent (obtained from CheckCle dashboard)

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Optional name for this server (leave empty for auto-detection)

variables.name: Server Token
variables.description: Authentication token for connecting to CheckCle server

variables.name: CheckCle URL
variables.description: URL of your CheckCle server (e.g., https://checkcle.example.com)
